title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on an outing with Fuji Kiseki one day, when…
"Trainer! Trainer! Won't you dance a fun little dance with me?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It feels like the voice came from inside a nearby claw machine filled with plush toys…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I really got you there! It was just me. Did you like my little trick?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just look at all the adorable ponies they've got here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wish I could let them out and bring them to the stage, but…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It would take a lot of work to win them… Gosh, just what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me an imploring smile, and I take her not-so-subtle hint.
choice_data_list: I'll get as many of them as possible!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There may be consequences if you don't get any, so do your best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
